name_zh: 松（幹微右傾、冠較高較窄、長枝往右後）
work_pack: 2026-11-14 樹木重做 v2：照天空島世界樹的做法（B：針葉和大喬木）
method: docs/execution/2026-11-14/tree-method（天空島世界樹）：S 形主幹、不對稱主枝、三級枝、葉冠錨點＋枝梢流、五頂點立體葉、頂點色
origin: trunk base centre, z = 0 on the ground; roots go down to z = -0.3
collision_note: TR01_B_Pine_Collision: 8-sided prism round the trunk (radius 0.39 m, z 0-3 m); hide its renderer, use it as a MeshCollider or a CapsuleCollider of the same size. The crown does not block.
leaf_geometry: pine fascicles: five vertices, two triangles - two needles leave one base and open 16-34 deg (a V in 3D); LOD0 0.52-0.70 m x 0.10-0.13 m, 9-12 per brush; a brush sweeps forward along its shoot (a pine shoot brush, a little flattened), brushes follow each tip twig from 30 % of its length to the tip; LOD1 0.75-0.95 m x 0.16-0.21 m, 6-8 per brush; LOD2 1.2-1.5 m x 0.34-0.44 m, 4-5 per brush; LOD3: two crossed impostor cards
leaf_material: opaque (no alpha), both faces drawn, roughness about 0.9, metallic 0; BaseColor = the palette texture on UV0 (or multiply the vertex colour instead)
vertex_colour: Color (FBX vertex colour, linear): leaves RGB = leaf colour from height / inside-outside, A = canopy occlusion (not transparency); wood RGB 1, A 1
wind: UV1 "Wind": u = sway weight (trunk 0, limbs 0.03-0.3, secondaries 0.3-0.5, tips 0.5-0.8, leaves 0.62-1), v = phase 0..1
lod3: two crossed cards with a front impostor of LOD0 (impostor atlas column 1)
texture_naming: BaseColor = Albedo; MetallicSmoothness = URP mask (R metallic 0, A smoothness), same naming as village-houses-b (VL)
